purpose: Gate 0 capability-matrix seed (docs/defi/REGISTRY_AND_CAPABILITY_SEED.md). State is derived as flag AND registry AND feed AND dossier (flags do not exist yet — G0 adds no code — so every DeFi-facing capability is unsupported today). 'note' fields are seed annotations, not part of the S5 wire shape.

evidenceRef: docs/AUDIT_REPORT.md gate C 2026-10-04 popup send observation
features.note: Wallet-core capability; live reads observed working in the 2026-10-04 popup smoke.

Ships in the wallet today, but LIVE end-to-end semantics are OPEN (recipient-owner acceptance, token-program fee). Dependent DeFi features inherit TOKEN_PATH_UNVERIFIED until dossier Q13 (= P3) closes on a reachable machine.
Q14-Q16 and Q19 open; R2 requires a verified sell before any buy; R6 restricts built-in flows to registry programs.
Q15 pool model, Q17 native-THRU pool path and Q18 discovery open; add-liquidity stays disabled until remove is verified live (R2).
P3 (Q13) is a hard precondition per B1. Q11 authority-revocation model and Q12 canonical-account rule also gate the template authority policy.
B8 enables models strictly in order: mint-only, then direct AMM pool, then curve.
No curve/launch program found package-side (Q20); live search open; D1 forbids a project-authored curve in this workstream.
Q21 (graduation trigger/caller/atomicity/LP disposition) unanswered; also needs the destination-pool griefing check (DESTINATION_POOL_PRE_EXISTING).
No project read API provided and no official public indexer verified (Q9). Candle data must never be fabricated.
Same dependency as charts; by-address token pages and own-launch reads remain direct-chain once their prerequisites verify.
tx.simulate is a declared-unsupported stub; the fetched spec pages document no simulate endpoint (Q5 open). Until Q5: decoder-only reviews labelled unsimulated, no Max where fees unmeasured.
D8: USD for native THRU only, and only with a verified source (Q22). scripts/probe-oracle-feed.mjs is the pending probe. Until then: dash, never a guess.

limits.note: PROJECT INPUTS section 5 starting values (owner left all inputs blank = defaults). slippageDefault 50 bps applies to verified assets; 300 bps is the suggested default for unverified/curve assets; 2000 bps cap is Desktop-advanced-only with typed confirmation. These are proposals for the product owner, not facts.

contractVersion.note: Corrected at recon: repo is contract v16 with 81 methods (the prompts assumed 15/83, i.e. 16 and 17). READ surface takes the next free version, EXEC the one after.

feedSummary.note: No feed publisher provided in PROJECT INPUTS section 3. Where policy requires a feed (verified list, kill switch) the applicable reason is FEED_MISSING, falling back to the stricter unverified-asset policy. Signed-feed verification must tolerate an absent publisher (R16 kill switch is a narrowing-only control when it exists).
